# Code By Dalin

> Learn coding like a tree grows. Roots=Variables, Trunk=Logic, Branches=Loops. Beginner programming book by 18yo creator @dalin_kat (Dalin Kats).

## What is Code By Dalin?
Code By Dalin is a beginner-friendly programming book that teaches coding from zero using a tree analogy:
- Roots = Variables and Types (Chapter 1)
- Trunk = Logic, if/else (Chapter 2)  
- Branches = Loops and Functions (Chapter 3)
- Canopy = Build a real calculator app (Chapter 4)

JavaScript + Python examples. You build as you learn.

- Name: Dalin Kats (Darex Kats Jr.)
